name: founder-quote
description: Founder's note: eyebrow and title, then a rounded portrait with the Asset Panda logo beside a pull quote, the note itself and the attribution. Live: .apx-fdr "Why we built it" on the Asset Intelligence Platform page.

logo.description: Logo laid over the portrait's corner.

pull_accent.description: Pull quote's second line, painted with the brand gradient.

body.description: The note, one paragraph per item. Wrap bold runs in **double asterisks**; "UrsaAI" is drawn as the brand mark.

author.description: Who wrote it (an em dash is added).

cta_label.description: Optional gradient button under the attribution, inside the ruled quote block (Partners: Email Today). Renders only with cta_url.

cta_url.description: Button destination (a page, #anchor, http(s), mailto: or tel:).

photo_fade.description: The soft white fade in the portrait's bottom-right corner. Turn it off when the logo laid over that corner is white (Partners).
